paper.title: Deep Spatiotemporal Learning for Battery Prognostics using Incremental Capacity Curve Image Transformation
paper.abstract: framework that integrates incremental capacity (IC) analysis with a deep spatiotemporal learning architecture. IC curves are computed from differential voltage-capacity (dQ/dV) data to isolate peak shifts and area variations, which serve as indicators of loss of lithium inventory and loss of active material. To preserve the high-dimensional dependencies of these aging signatures, the IC curves are transformed into a structured sequence of temporal images. This encoding allows the model to extract spatial features related to curve morphology while simultaneously tracking their non-linear evolution across cycles. As illustrated in Fig. 1, a specialized neural network is utilized to process these multidimensional representations, effectively mapping subtle electrochemical transitions to the State of Health (SoH) and Remaining Useful Life (RUL).
